# dsh-pomodoro-timer
A Pomodoro timer for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: a **sidebar page** with focus / short-break / long
-break cycles, plus a **countdown pill** beside the composer.
English | 简体中文
Repository: <https://github.com/cuznmop/dsh-pomodoro-timer> · Issues: <https://github.com/cuznmop/ds
h-pomodoro-timer/issues> · Package: <https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-pomodoro-timer>
## Features
- **Sidebar page** — clock icon in the left panel list opens a full page with a progress ring, contr

ols, and statistics.
- **Composer pill** — a compact countdown next to the message box; click it to

jump to the page. It keeps running while you work in chat.
- **Cycle control** — focus 25 / short br
eak 5 / long break 15 minutes by default, a long break every 4 pomodoros, and an optional auto-start

for the next phase.
- **Controls** — start, pause, resume, reset the current phase, skip to the nex

t phase.
- **Statistics** — the pomodoro number in the current round and how many you finished today

; the counter rolls over at midnight.
- **Chime** — three short tones when a phase ends naturally (c

an be turned off; the page needs one interaction before the browser allows audio).
- **Survives a re
load** — the running deadline is stored in `localStorage`, so refreshing the page resumes the same c

ountdown.
- **Light and dark themes** — every colour is a `--dsw-alias-*` theme token; the plugin im

ports no Harness client package, so it does not break when those internals change.
- **Bilingual** —
Simplified Chinese and English, following the GUI language.
## Requirements
| Component | Requirement |
| DeepSeek Harness | verified on `0.2.0-rc.2` (Web/Desktop profiles); the plugin uses only the publi

c client `slots` and `locale` services, and declares no DSH peer dependency |
| DSH profile | a Web

surface (`web`, or the Desktop app); headless profiles have no UI |
| Node.js | `^22.19.0` or `>=24.
0.0` (only for the optional local check) |
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
In the Desktop app, install `dsh-pomodoro-timer` from the plugin market page, or from **Settings → P
lugins**. Restart Harness (or reload the page) afterwards, then look for the clock icon in the sideb
art Harness (or reload the page) afterwards, then look for the clock icon in the sidebar panel list.
## Usage
| Control | Behaviour |

| Start / Pause | Start or pause the current phase |
| Reset | Restore the current phase to its full

length and pause |
| Skip | Move to the next phase without crediting a pomodoro |
| Settings | Focu
s length, short break, long break, pomodoros per long break, auto-start, chime |
Changing a duration while a phase is paused resizes it immediately; while it is running, the change
applies from the next phase.
State lives under the `dsh.plugin.pomodoro-timer.v1` key in `localStorage`.

## Development
No build step: `client.js` is the published browser bundle. The package ships a self-contained offli
step: `client.js` is the published browser bundle. The package ships a self-contained offline check.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`test/client.test.mjs` loads the browser bundle with a module-loader stub and a fake client context
and exercises registration ids, the phase machine, persistence, and component rendering. It proves l
ogic, not looks — visual verification needs the running GUI.
### Layout
| Path | Responsibility |

| `package.json` | manifest: bundle patch, client declaration, export map, icon, file allowlist |
|

`cordis.patch.yml` | inserts the Host row that puts the browser bundle in the module graph |
| `inde

x.js` | Host half — intentionally a no-op |
| `client.js` | the timer store, the sidebar page, the c

omposer pill, and both dictionaries |
| `locale/*.json` | plugin-card title and description |
| `ico

n.svg` | plugin-card artwork |
| `test/client.test.mjs` | offline check |
## Notes
- The plugin reads and writes nothing but its own `localStorage` key. It has no host-side service, n

o tool, and no network access.
- It registers into `sidebar.panellist`, `main`, and `conversation.co
mposer.dock`; it never replaces the app root and never appends to `document.body`.
